old_caption: The video captures a woman in a dance studio, engaging in a choreographed routine. She is dressed in a vibrant blue sleeveless top, paired with matching blue shorts and black knee-high boots. Her long dark hair flows freely as she moves gracefully across the floor. The studio itself is minimalist, featuring white walls and a light wooden floor that reflects the bright overhead lights. A large mirror spans one wall, reflecting her movements and adding depth to the scene. The woman begins by facing away from the camera, extending her arms out to the sides. As she turns, she continues to move fluidly, her arms and legs coordinating in a rhythmic dance. The camera remains stationary throughout, focusing on her performance and capturing the seamless flow of her movements against the backdrop of the studio's clean lines and reflective surfaces.

caption: The video captures a woman with long dark hair, in a blue knotted top, denim shorts and black thigh-high boots, positioned back to a fixed camera in a bright white studio. A mirror wall in front of her shows her front-facing reflection on the right. She dances in place, her position remaining roughly constant. One arm stays bent near her head and shoulder, sometimes extending outward to the side, while the other arm moves from an extended outward reach to a lower position by her side. In the mirror, the bent arm reads as a horizontal line across her chest, and the other arm appears extended downward. Her weight shifts between the two boots, with heels lifting and feet pivoting rather than traveling across the light wood floor. The knotted front of her top shifts slightly as her torso turns.

This is a TEMPORALLY CROPPED EXCERPT from a longer video, not a complete event or a loop.

endpoints are normal, not physical errors. Do not add unseen causes, onset, stopping or outcomes.
An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

Check identification before physical interpretation: a reflection is not a separate actor;
a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.
Do not claim contact, bending, compression, melting, disintegration or structural recovery unless
the appropriate material/surface itself provides visible evidence. Do not infer a force or earlier
collision just because the visible configuration would be compatible with it.
Compare several frames before asserting translation, rotation, direction, unchanged position or
camera tracking. A single visible texture/seam does not prove spin. Avoid unnecessary absolute
claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.
Remove invented scene details and explanations, but keep clearly visible ongoing motion and
processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.

Retain the WISA English narrative style, detail density and paragraph structure. Aim for the
provided original word count within 85%-115%, using genuinely visible details and process.
Do not add repetition, watermark/logo descriptions or atmospheric filler to reach a word count.
Do not shorten a rich caption into a terse technical checklist. Avoid annotation phrases such as
'this mid-segment', 'the excerpt', 'the frame', 'these images', 'observed evidence' in the caption.
This is a direct video description, not an analysis note. No mandatory beginning/end formula.
Complete every sentence. If accuracy requires a substantial length difference, explain it outside
the caption; do not fill missing context by imagination. Optional synonym edits are not needed.

draft_caption: The video captures a woman with long dark hair, in a blue knotted top, denim shorts and black thigh-high boots, standing back to a fixed camera in a bright white studio. A full-wall mirror in front of her shows her front-facing reflection on the right. She performs a dance sequence in place, her position in the frame staying roughly constant. One arm moves between an extended reach out to the side and a bent position raised toward the head. The other arm alternates between hanging low and being lifted with the elbow bent. In the mirror the same body mirrors these gestures, the extended arm reading as a horizontal line across her chest. Her weight rocks between the two boots, heels lifting and feet rotating rather than traveling across the light wood floor. The knotted tail of her top swings from hip to hip as her torso turns, the excerpt holding this motion without showing its start or finish.
